summary: Review release announcements and launch posts for user impact, evidence, migration caveats, availability scope and action clarity without turning the review into product release readiness.

must_inspect.why: Availability and rollout claims should match actual scope and prerequisites.
false_positive_guards: Do not infer production readiness from announcement wording.

must_inspect.why: The announcement should connect changes to user tasks without inventing outcomes.
false_positive_guards: Do not require quantified outcomes when the claim is descriptive rather than performance-based.
Treat this pack as review configuration, not as evidence or an automatic severity increase.
